critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/brain/costs (routes/brain_routes.py:132) forwards account_id but the endpoint does NOT accept a live signal, so the account_config commission branch inside expected_cost_r can never resolve via that endpoint (risk_per_lot is None → falls to realized_deals or default). This is fine for the current UI (which reads it as an estimator) but if callers expect account-config to surface here, the endpoint would need to accept entry_price/stop_loss (or symbol contract specs) query params. Not blocking — verified via bot_runner path which does pass the live signal.
